source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(httr)

library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY CURRENT & BASELINE RUNS FROM PARAMS OR SQL SUMMARY

if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$current_run) && params$current_run %in% db_run_summary$run_id) {
  current_run <- db_run_summary %>% filter(run_id == params$current_run) %>% slice(1)
} else {
  current_run <- db_run_summary %>% filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num)) %>% slice(1)
}

if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$baseline_run) && params$baseline_run %in% db_run_summary$run_id && params$baseline_run != "NONE") {
  baseline_run <- db_run_summary %>% filter(run_id == params$baseline_run) %>% slice(1)
} else if (nrow(db_run_summary) > 1) {
  baseline_run <- db_run_summary %>% filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num)) %>% slice(1)
} else {
  baseline_run <- current_run
}

current_run_id  <- current_run$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline_run$run_id[1]
has_baseline    <- (!is.na(baseline_run_id) && baseline_run_id != "NONE" && current_run_id != baseline_run_id)

project_name  <- current_run$project_name[1]
scenario_name <- current_run$test_name[1]

applications <- db_app_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  arrange(app_name) %>%
  pull(app_name)
application_list <- paste(applications, collapse = ", ")
num_apps <- length(applications)

current_duration  <- paste0(current_run$duration_mins[1], " mins")
baseline_duration <- paste0(baseline_run$duration_mins[1], " mins")

if (!exists("is_flag_enabled")) {
  is_flag_enabled <- function(val, default = TRUE) {
    if (is.null(val)) return(default)
    if (is.logical(val)) return(isTRUE(val))
    val_str <- tolower(trimws(as.character(val)))
    if (val_str %in% c("false", "no", "0", "off", "disabled")) return(FALSE)
    if (val_str %in% c("true", "yes", "1", "on", "enabled")) return(TRUE)
    default
  }
}

tz_cfg <- if (exists("params_cfg") && !is.null(params_cfg$timezone)) params_cfg$timezone else NULL
raw_source_tz <- if (is.list(tz_cfg) && !is.null(tz_cfg$source_timezone)) trimws(as.character(tz_cfg$source_timezone)) else "UTC"
raw_display_tz <- if (is.character(tz_cfg) && length(tz_cfg) == 1) {
  trimws(tz_cfg)
} else if (is.list(tz_cfg) && !is.null(tz_cfg$display_timezone)) {
  trimws(as.character(tz_cfg$display_timezone))
} else {
  "Pacific/Auckland"
}
show_tz_abbr <- if (is.list(tz_cfg) && !is.null(tz_cfg$show_timezone_abbr)) is_flag_enabled(tz_cfg$show_timezone_abbr, TRUE) else TRUE

resolve_valid_tz <- function(tz_str, fallback = "UTC") {
  if (is.null(tz_str) || !nzchar(tz_str) || tolower(tz_str) %in% c("local", "system")) {
    sys_tz <- Sys.timezone()
    if (!is.na(sys_tz) && nzchar(sys_tz) && sys_tz %in% OlsonNames()) return(sys_tz)
    return(fallback)
  }
  if (tz_str %in% OlsonNames()) return(tz_str)
  warning(sprintf("Unrecognised timezone '%s' in config.yaml; falling back to '%s'.", tz_str, fallback))
  fallback
}

source_tz  <- resolve_valid_tz(raw_source_tz, "UTC")
display_tz <- resolve_valid_tz(raw_display_tz, "Pacific/Auckland")

convert_db_ts <- function(ts_val) {
  if (is.null(ts_val) || is.na(ts_val)) return(ts_val)
  if (identical(source_tz, "UTC")) return(ts_val)
  wall_str <- format(ts_val, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")
  as.POSIXct(wall_str, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = source_tz)
}

format_run_ts <- function(ts_val, fmt_str, append_tz = FALSE) {
  ts_conv <- convert_db_ts(ts_val)
  out <- format(ts_conv, fmt_str, tz = display_tz)
  if (isTRUE(append_tz)) {
    tz_abbr <- format(ts_conv, "%Z", tz = display_tz)
    if (nzchar(tz_abbr)) out <- paste0(out, " ", tz_abbr)
  }
  out
}

current_start_fmt  <- format_run_ts(current_run$start_time[1],  "%d %b %Y, %I:%M %p", append_tz = FALSE)
current_end_fmt    <- format_run_ts(current_run$end_time[1],    "%I:%M %p",           append_tz = show_tz_abbr)
baseline_start_fmt <- format_run_ts(baseline_run$start_time[1], "%d %b %Y, %I:%M %p", append_tz = FALSE)
baseline_end_fmt   <- format_run_ts(baseline_run$end_time[1],   "%I:%M %p",           append_tz = show_tz_abbr)

status_colour <- function(status, enabled = TRUE) {
  if (!isTRUE(enabled) || !isTRUE(show_overall_status) || identical(status, "INFO")) return("#2563EB")
  if (identical(status, "PASS")) return("#16A34A")
  if (identical(status, "FAIL")) return("#DC2626")
  "#64748B"
}

metric_badge <- function(value, passed, suffix = "", enabled = TRUE) {
  if (!isTRUE(enabled) || !isTRUE(show_overall_status)) {
    return(sprintf("<span style='font-weight:600;'>%s%s</span>", value, suffix))
  }
  sprintf(
    "<span class='%s'>%s%s</span>",
    ifelse(isTRUE(passed), "status-pass", "status-fail"),
    value,
    suffix
  )
}

inline_delta_badge <- function(current_val, baseline_val, lower_is_better = FALSE) {
  if (!has_baseline || is.na(current_val) || is.na(baseline_val)) return("")
  if (baseline_val == 0) {
    if (current_val == 0) return("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-neutral'>▬ 0.0%</span>")
    cls <- if (lower_is_better) "hd-delta-fail" else "hd-delta-pass"
    return(sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline %s'>▲ New</span>", cls))
  }
  delta <- round(((current_val - baseline_val) / baseline_val) * 100, 1)
  if (delta == 0) {
    return("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-neutral'>▬ 0.0%</span>")
  }
  is_good <- if (lower_is_better) (delta < 0) else (delta > 0)
  cls     <- if (is_good) "hd-delta-pass" else "hd-delta-fail"
  arrow   <- if (delta > 0) "▲" else "▼"
  sign_ch <- if (delta > 0) "+" else "-"
  sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline %s'>%s %s%.1f%%</span>", cls, arrow, sign_ch, abs(delta))
}

delta_text <- function(current_val, baseline_val, lower_is_better = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(current_val) || is.na(baseline_val)) return("—")
  if (baseline_val == 0) {
    if (current_val == 0) return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
    return("<span class='status-fail'>▲ Increase</span>")
  }
  delta <- round(((current_val - baseline_val) / baseline_val) * 100, 1)
  if (delta == 0) return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
  is_good <- if (lower_is_better) (delta < 0) else (delta > 0)
  cls     <- if (is_good) "status-pass" else "status-fail"
  arrow   <- if (delta > 0) "▲" else "▼"
  sign_ch <- if (delta > 0) "+" else "-"
  sprintf("<span class='%s'>%s %s%.1f%%</span>", cls, arrow, sign_ch, abs(delta))
}

safe_dom_id <- function(x) {
  gsub("^_+|_+$", "", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", as.character(x)))
}

# ============================================================
# 2B. INFRASTRUCTURE EVIDENCE (CPU / Memory screenshots)
#     Drop images into <evidence_dir>/<run_id>/ (default: Evidence/<run_id>/)
#     Optional <run_id>/evidence.yaml maps "filename.png: Caption text".
#     Nothing found => no tab, no button, report is unchanged.
# ============================================================
evidence_root <- if (!is.null(params_cfg$evidence_dir) && nzchar(trimws(params_cfg$evidence_dir))) params_cfg$evidence_dir else "Evidence"
if (!grepl("^(//|\\\\\\\\|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|/)", evidence_root)) evidence_root <- here::here(evidence_root)

collect_evidence <- function(run_id) {
  rid <- as.character(run_id)
  cand_dirs <- unique(c(
    file.path(evidence_root, rid),
    here::here("RawResults", rid, "evidence"),
    here::here("RawResults", rid)
  ))
  existing_dirs <- cand_dirs[dir.exists(cand_dirs)]
  if (length(existing_dirs) == 0) return(NULL)

  files <- character(0)
  active_dir <- NULL
  for (d in existing_dirs) {
    found <- list.files(d, pattern = "\\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(found) > 0) {
      files <- found[order(basename(found))]
      active_dir <- d
      break
    }
  }
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  captions <- tryCatch({
    yml <- file.path(active_dir, "evidence.yaml")
    if (file.exists(yml)) yaml::read_yaml(yml) else list()
  }, error = function(e) list())
  lapply(files, function(f) {
    cap <- captions[[basename(f)]]
    if (is.null(cap)) cap <- gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("[_-]+", " ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))
    list(caption = as.character(cap), uri = knitr::image_uri(f))
  })
}

render_evidence_cards <- function(items) {
  paste(vapply(items, function(it) {
    sprintf('<figure class="hd-evidence-card"><figcaption>%s</figcaption><img src="%s" alt="%s" /></figure>',
            htmlEscape(it$caption), it$uri, htmlEscape(it$caption))
  }, character(1)), collapse = "\n")
}

evidence_cur  <- collect_evidence(current_run_id)
evidence_base <- if (has_baseline) collect_evidence(baseline_run_id) else NULL
has_evidence  <- !is.null(evidence_cur) || !is.null(evidence_base)

evidence_tab_ids <- character(0)
evidence_tabs_html <- ""
evidence_panels_html <- ""
if (has_evidence) {
  groups <- list()
  if (!is.null(evidence_cur))  groups$CURRENT  <- list(title = sprintf("Current Run #%s", current_run_id),  items = evidence_cur)
  if (!is.null(evidence_base)) groups$BASELINE <- list(title = sprintf("Baseline Run #%s", baseline_run_id), items = evidence_base)

  evidence_tab_ids <- c("ALL", names(groups))
  n_all <- sum(vapply(groups, function(g) length(g$items), integer(1)))
  tabs <- sprintf('<label for="hd-tab-evidence-ALL" class="hd-modal-tab-btn" data-mode="evidence" data-tab-id="ALL">All Evidence (%d)</label>', n_all)
  for (gid in names(groups)) {
    tabs <- paste0(tabs, sprintf('<label for="hd-tab-evidence-%s" class="hd-modal-tab-btn" data-mode="evidence" data-tab-id="%s">%s (%d)</label>',
                                 gid, gid, groups[[gid]]$title, length(groups[[gid]]$items)))
  }
  evidence_tabs_html <- tabs

  group_html <- function(g) sprintf('<h4 class="hd-evidence-heading">%s</h4><div class="hd-evidence-grid">%s</div>', htmlEscape(g$title), render_evidence_cards(g$items))
  evidence_panels_html <- paste(
    c(
      sprintf('<div id="evidence-data-ALL" class="hd-tab-panel">%s</div>', paste(vapply(groups, group_html, character(1)), collapse = "\n")),
      vapply(names(groups), function(gid) sprintf('<div id="evidence-data-%s" class="hd-tab-panel">%s</div>', gid, group_html(groups[[gid]])), character(1))
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

current_key <- as.character(current_run_id)

if (isTRUE(vu_sla_enabled) && !is.null(sla_results[[current_key]])) {
  vu_rules <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, "total_users"), sla_results[[current_key]]$rules)

    vu_rule   <- vu_rules[[1]]

  }
}

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

# Map label RT outcomes onto Scenarios
cur_scen_map <- db_label_scen_map %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id)

joined_labels_all <- tibble(
  app_name = character(), logical_scenario = character(), label = character(),
  actual_rt = numeric(), threshold = numeric(), passed = logical(),
  breach_pct = numeric(), tx_count = integer(), errors = integer(), error_rate = numeric()
)

logical_rt_summary <- tibble(
  app_name = character(), logical_scenario = character(),
  total_labels = integer(), passed_labels = integer(), failed_labels = integer(),
  logical_rt_passed = logical(), worst_label = character(),
  worst_actual = numeric(), worst_sla = numeric(), worst_breach_pct = numeric()
)

if (!is.null(rt_summary) && !is.null(rt_summary$all_labels) && nrow(rt_summary$all_labels) > 0) {
  joined_labels_all <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    inner_join(cur_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
    distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, actual_rt, threshold, passed, breach_pct, tx_count, errors, error_rate)

  logical_rt_summary <- joined_labels_all %>%
    group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
    summarise(
      total_labels      = n(),
      passed_labels     = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      failed_labels     = sum(!passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      logical_rt_passed = all(passed),
      worst_label       = if (any(!passed)) label[which.max(breach_pct)] else "-",
      worst_actual      = if (any(!passed)) max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      worst_sla         = if (any(!passed)) threshold[which.max(breach_pct)] else 0,
      worst_breach_pct  = if (any(!passed)) max(breach_pct, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      .groups           = "drop"
    )
}

# Build Scenario Health DF (grouped by clean Scenario name)
logical_health_df <- db_logical_scenario_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  left_join(logical_rt_summary, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    logical_rt_passed  = if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) ifelse(is.na(logical_rt_passed), TRUE, logical_rt_passed) else TRUE,
    scenario_rt_passed = logical_rt_passed,
    failed_labels      = if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) ifelse(is.na(failed_labels), 0L, failed_labels) else 0L,
    thread_group       = logical_scenario
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    error_target    = get_app_error_threshold(app_name),
    error_passed    = if (isTRUE(er_sla_enabled)) (error_rate <= error_target) else TRUE,
    scenario_passed = isTRUE(logical_rt_passed) && isTRUE(error_passed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

scenario_health_df <- logical_health_df

app_health <- cur_apps %>%
  left_join(base_apps, by = "app_name") %>%

           <span class="hd-meta-tag" style="background:#DBEAFE;color:#1E40AF;">Current Run #%s</span>
           <span class="hd-meta-item">⏱ <strong>%s</strong></span>
         </div>
         <div class="hd-meta-row">
           <span class="hd-meta-item hd-meta-ts">(%s – %s)</span>
         </div>
       </div>
       <div class="hd-meta-group hd-meta-group-stack">
         <div class="hd-meta-row">
           <span class="hd-meta-tag">Baseline Run #%s</span>
           <span class="hd-meta-item">⏱ <strong>%s</strong></span>
         </div>
         <div class="hd-meta-row">
           <span class="hd-meta-item hd-meta-ts">(%s – %s)</span>
         </div>
       </div>
       <div class="hd-topbar-actions">
         <label for="hd-mode-charts" class="hd-modal-btn hd-topbar-btn" data-open-mode="charts" data-open-tab="GRID" style="background:#EFF6FF;border-color:#93C5FD;color:#1D4ED8;margin:0;">📈 Executive Charts 🔍</label>
         %s
         <label for="hd-mode-glossary" class="hd-modal-btn hd-topbar-btn" data-open-mode="glossary" data-open-tab="ALL" style="background:#F0FDF4;border-color:#BBF7D0;color:#166534;margin:0;">📖 Performance Glossary 🔍</label>
         %s
       </div>
     </div>
     <div class="hd-topbar-apps-row">
       <span class="hd-meta-item">🖥 <strong>Applications:</strong> %s</span>
       <label for="hd-theme-toggle-state" id="hd-theme-toggle-btn" class="hd-theme-toggle-btn" title="Switch between Light and Dark theme" style="margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;"><span class="hd-theme-label-dark">🌙 Dark</span><span class="hd-theme-label-light">☀️ Light</span></label>
     </div>
   </div>',
  topbar_class,
  project_name,
  scenario_name,
  current_run_id,
  current_duration,
  current_start_fmt,
  current_end_fmt,
  baseline_run_id,
  baseline_duration,
  baseline_start_fmt,
  baseline_end_fmt,
  slarules_btn_html,
  evidence_btn_html,
  application_list
)

# Run-over-run latency delta used by the executive narrative
rt_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$pct_rt[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$pct_rt[1] - baseline_run$pct_rt[1]) / baseline_run$pct_rt[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0
tp_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$throughput[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$throughput[1] - baseline_run$throughput[1]) / baseline_run$throughput[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0
er_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$error_rate[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$error_rate[1] - baseline_run$error_rate[1]) / baseline_run$error_rate[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0

# --- Executive Narrative Generation (Hybrid: Amplify AI with Deterministic Fallback) ---
app_names_list <- unique(app_health$app_name)
app_names_str  <- paste(app_names_list, collapse = ", ")
if (!nzchar(app_names_str)) app_names_str <- "the system"

env_str <- if (grepl("prod", tolower(current_run$test_name[1]))) {
  "PROD"
} else if (grepl("uat|staging|stage", tolower(current_run$test_name[1]))) {
  "UAT"
} else {
  "UAT"
}

test_type_str <- if (grepl("peak", tolower(current_run$test_name[1]))) {
  "A peak load performance test"
} else if (grepl("stress", tolower(current_run$test_name[1]))) {
  "A stress performance test"
} else if (grepl("soak|endurance", tolower(current_run$test_name[1]))) {
  "A soak performance test"
} else {
  "A peak load performance test"
}

cfg <- tryCatch({
  if (exists("params_cfg") && is.list(params_cfg) && length(params_cfg) > 0) {
    params_cfg
  } else if (file.exists(here::here("config.yaml"))) {
    yaml::read_yaml(here::here("config.yaml"))
  } else if (file.exists("config.yaml")) {
    yaml::read_yaml("config.yaml")
  } else if (file.exists("../config.yaml")) {
    yaml::read_yaml("../config.yaml")
  } else list()
}, error = function(e) list())

dur_mins <- as.numeric(current_run$duration_mins[1])
workload_cfg <- if (!is.null(cfg$workload_profile)) cfg$workload_profile else if (!is.null(cfg$workload)) cfg$workload else list()

cfg_ramp_up   <- if (!is.null(workload_cfg$ramp_up)) trimws(as.character(workload_cfg$ramp_up)) else ""
cfg_steady    <- if (!is.null(workload_cfg$steady_state)) trimws(as.character(workload_cfg$steady_state)) else ""
cfg_ramp_down <- if (!is.null(workload_cfg$ramp_down)) trimws(as.character(workload_cfg$ramp_down)) else ""

auto_ramp_m <- if ("ramp_up_mins" %in% names(current_run) && !is.na(current_run$ramp_up_mins[1])) {
  as.numeric(current_run$ramp_up_mins[1])
} else if (!is.na(dur_mins) && dur_mins >= 30) {
  min(10, max(5, round(dur_mins * 0.15)))
} else {
  10
}

auto_ramp_down_m <- if ("ramp_down_mins" %in% names(current_run) && !is.na(current_run$ramp_down_mins[1])) {
  as.numeric(current_run$ramp_down_mins[1])
} else {
  0
}

auto_steady_m <- if ("steady_state_mins" %in% names(current_run) && !is.na(current_run$steady_state_mins[1])) {
  as.numeric(current_run$steady_state_mins[1])
} else if (!is.na(dur_mins) && dur_mins >= 30) {
  max(1, round(dur_mins - auto_ramp_m - auto_ramp_down_m))
} else {
  60
}

val_ramp_up <- if (nzchar(cfg_ramp_up)) {
  cfg_ramp_up
} else if (auto_ramp_m <= 0) {
  "immediate ramp-up (0s)"
} else {
  sprintf("%d-minute ramp-up (%ds)", auto_ramp_m, auto_ramp_m * 60)
}

val_steady_state <- if (nzchar(cfg_steady)) {
  cfg_steady
} else {
  sprintf("%d minutes steady state", auto_steady_m)
}

val_ramp_down <- if (nzchar(cfg_ramp_down)) {
  if (tolower(cfg_ramp_down) %in% c("none", "0", "0m", "0s")) "" else cfg_ramp_down
} else if (auto_ramp_down_m > 0) {
  sprintf("%d-minute ramp-down (%ds)", auto_ramp_down_m, auto_ramp_down_m * 60)
} else {
  ""
}

duration_desc <- if (nzchar(val_ramp_down)) {
  sprintf("a %s followed by %s and a %s ramp-down",
          sub("^a\\s+", "", val_ramp_up),
          val_steady_state,
          sub("^a\\s+|\\s*ramp-down$", "", val_ramp_down))
} else {
  sprintf("a %s followed by %s",
          sub("^a\\s+", "", val_ramp_up),
          val_steady_state)
}

current_rt_fmt <- format(round(current_run$pct_rt[1]), big.mark = ",")
rt_comp_str <- if (has_baseline) {
  if (rt_delta_pct < -1) {
    sprintf("showed an overall ~%.1f%% %s latency improvement versus baseline run #%s (current %s %s ms)",
            abs(rt_delta_pct), rt_metric_name, baseline_run_id, rt_metric_name, current_rt_fmt)
  } else if (rt_delta_pct > 1) {
    sprintf("showed an overall +%.1f%% %s latency regression versus baseline run #%s (current %s %s ms)",
            abs(rt_delta_pct), rt_metric_name, baseline_run_id, rt_metric_name, current_rt_fmt)
  } else {
    sprintf("showed consistent overall %s latency versus baseline run #%s (current %s %s ms)",
            rt_metric_name, baseline_run_id, rt_metric_name, current_rt_fmt)
  }
} else {
  sprintf("achieved an overall %s response time of %s ms", rt_metric_name, current_rt_fmt)
}

worst_label <- "none"
worst_rt <- "0"
worst_sla <- format(round(rt_default), big.mark = ",")
flow_theme <- "key application flows"
breach_cnt <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled) && !is.null(rt_summary)) rt_summary$failed_count else if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) logical_rt_failed_cnt else 0L

if (!is.null(rt_summary) && nrow(rt_summary$top_breaches) > 0) {
  worst_row <- rt_summary$top_breaches[1, ]
  worst_label <- as.character(worst_row$label)
  worst_rt <- format(round(worst_row$actual_rt), big.mark = ",")
  worst_sla <- format(round(worst_row$threshold), big.mark = ",")

  all_breach_text <- tolower(paste(rt_summary$top_breaches$label, collapse = " "))
  flow_theme <- if (grepl("search|site|click", all_breach_text)) {
    "search and clicksite-related flows"
  } else if (grepl("login|auth|token", all_breach_text)) {
    "authentication and session flows"
  } else if (grepl("pay|checkout|order", all_breach_text)) {
    "checkout and transaction flows"
  } else {
    "the slowest transactions"
  }
} else if (!is.null(rt_summary) && !is.null(rt_summary$all_labels) && nrow(rt_summary$all_labels) > 0) {
  slowest_idx <- which.max(rt_summary$all_labels$actual_rt)
  worst_row <- rt_summary$all_labels[slowest_idx, ]
  worst_label <- as.character(worst_row$label)
  worst_rt <- format(round(worst_row$actual_rt), big.mark = ",")
  worst_sla <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) format(round(worst_row$threshold), big.mark = ",") else "N/A (SLA disabled)"

  lbl_lower <- tolower(worst_label)
  flow_theme <- if (grepl("search|site|click", lbl_lower)) {
    "search and clicksite-related flows"
  } else if (grepl("login|auth|token", lbl_lower)) {
    "authentication and session flows"
  } else if (grepl("pay|checkout|order", lbl_lower)) {
    "checkout and transaction flows"
  } else {
    "key application flows"
  }
}

# Deterministic Synthesis (Plain English)
det_p1 <- sprintf(
  "%s for <strong>%s (%s)</strong> ran with <strong>%s virtual users</strong> (%s), sustaining an average of <strong>%.2f TPS</strong> with a <strong>%.2f%% error rate</strong>. Overall, the run %s.",
  test_type_str,
  app_names_str,
  env_str,
  vu_actual,
  duration_desc,
  current_run$throughput[1],
  current_run$error_rate[1],
  rt_comp_str
)

det_p2 <- if (!isTRUE(show_overall_status) || !isTRUE(any_sla_enabled)) {
  if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled) && !is.null(rt_summary) && breach_cnt > 0) {
    sprintf(
      "Most transactions responded well under peak load, though <strong>%d transactions</strong> went over the <strong>%s ms</strong> %s target—most notably <strong>%s</strong> at <strong>%s ms</strong>. Reviewing and tuning these slower %s will help bring peak response times in line with the rest of the application.",
      breach_cnt, worst_sla, rt_metric_name, worst_label, worst_rt, flow_theme
    )
  } else if (!isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled) && nzchar(worst_label) && worst_label != "none") {
    sprintf(
      "Across the monitored scenarios, the highest %s response time was recorded on <strong>%s</strong> at <strong>%s ms</strong>. Reviewing the slowest %s will help identify opportunities for further tuning ahead of the next test run.",
      rt_metric_name, worst_label, worst_rt, flow_theme
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "All monitored transactions stayed comfortably within their %s response time targets throughout the test, showing steady performance under peak load.",
      rt_metric_name
    )
  }
} else if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  sprintf(
    "All monitored transactions met their response time targets with <strong>0 %s SLA breaches</strong> throughout peak load. The overall test status is <strong>PASS</strong>, and the application is ready for release under this workload.",
    rt_metric_name
  )
} else {
  if (logical_rt_failed_cnt > 0) {
    sprintf(
      "While throughput was steady and errors remained low, <strong>%d transactions</strong> exceeded the %s response time SLA, with <strong>%s</strong> reaching <strong>%s ms</strong> against a <strong>%s ms</strong> limit. Because of these breaches, the overall test status is <strong>FAIL</strong>—we recommend reviewing the slow %s and planning a fix before re-running the test.",
      breach_cnt, rt_metric_name, worst_label, worst_rt, worst_sla, flow_theme
    )
  } else if (logical_er_failed_cnt > 0) {
    sprintf(
      "The test recorded an elevated error rate of <strong>%.2f%%</strong> (%s failed requests), which is above the allowed threshold. The overall test status is <strong>FAIL</strong>, and backend errors should be investigated and resolved before the next test run.",
      current_run$error_rate[1], format(current_run$failed_tx[1], big.mark = ",")
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "The test did not reach its target concurrency or throughput goals, resulting in an overall status of <strong>FAIL</strong>."
    )
  }
}

duration_retest_str <- if (nzchar(val_ramp_down)) {
  sprintf("%s + %s + %s", val_ramp_up, val_steady_state, val_ramp_down)
} else {
  sprintf("%s + %s", val_ramp_up, val_steady_state)
}

det_next_steps <- if (!isTRUE(show_overall_status)) {
  if (!is.null(rt_summary) && breach_cnt > 0) {
    c(
      sprintf("Investigate <strong>%s</strong> and check application and database logs during peak load to see what caused the slower response times.", worst_label),
      "Apply targeted tuning (such as query optimisation or caching) to the slowest transactions shown in the breakdown table.",
      sprintf("Run a follow-up test (%s) to compare results against Run #%s.", duration_retest_str, current_run_id)
    )
  } else {
    c(
      sprintf("Keep Run #%s as the baseline reference for future performance test cycles.", current_run_id),
      "Continue tracking server CPU, memory, and response time trends in upcoming releases.",
      "Share these test results with the project and engineering teams."
    )
  }
} else if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  c(
    sprintf("Use Run #%s as the new baseline for future release test cycles.", current_run_id),
    "Save the server and APM monitoring metrics from this run as the benchmark profile.",
    "Proceed with performance sign-off for the release."
  )
} else if (logical_rt_failed_cnt > 0) {
  c(
    sprintf("Investigate <strong>%s</strong> and correlate peak response times with server and database logs to find the bottleneck.", worst_label),
    "Apply targeted fixes to the slow endpoints and verify the improvement in a lower environment.",
    sprintf("Re-run the test under the same load profile (%s) to confirm all transactions meet their SLA.", duration_retest_str)
  )
} else if (logical_er_failed_cnt > 0) {
  c(
    "Check application and web server logs to find the root cause of the failing requests.",
    "Review database connection pools and downstream service limits under peak load.",
    "Re-run the test once the backend errors have been fixed."
  )
} else {
  c(
    "Check load generator CPU, memory, and network capacity.",
    "Review virtual user pacing and think-time settings in the test script.",
    "Re-run the test to confirm it reaches the target user load and throughput."
  )
}

final_p1 <- det_p1
final_p2 <- det_p2
final_next_steps <- det_next_steps

# --- Attempt Amplify AI Generation if Enabled ---
api_key <- tryCatch({
  sec_file <- if (file.exists(here::here("secrets.yaml"))) {
    here::here("secrets.yaml")
  } else if (file.exists(here::here(".engine/Archived/secrets.yaml"))) {
    here::here(".engine/Archived/secrets.yaml")
  } else if (file.exists("secrets.yaml")) {
    "secrets.yaml"
  } else if (file.exists("../secrets.yaml")) {
    "../secrets.yaml"
  } else NULL
  if (!is.null(sec_file)) {
    k <- yaml::read_yaml(sec_file)$amplify_token
    if (!is.null(k)) trimws(as.character(k)) else NULL
  } else NULL
}, error = function(e) NULL)

cfg_ai_enabled <- isTRUE(as.logical(cfg$ai_summary_enabled)) || identical(tolower(as.character(cfg$ai_summary_enabled)), "true")

if (isTRUE(cfg_ai_enabled) && !is.null(api_key) && nzchar(api_key)) {
  prompt_template <- if (!is.null(cfg$ai_prompt_template) && nzchar(trimws(cfg$ai_prompt_template))) {
    as.character(cfg$ai_prompt_template)
  } else {
    "Write a clear, natural executive summary of this performance test for project stakeholders.

Writing Style:
- Use plain, natural British English (e.g. optimised, prioritised, analysed, behaviour).
- Write the way an experienced performance engineer speaks to a delivery team: clear, conversational, and easy to read.
- Avoid stiff corporate jargon, robotic phrasing, or disconnected sentence fragments. Write in complete, natural sentences.
- Bold important numbers, transaction names, and outcomes inline (e.g. **289 virtual users**, **14.61 TPS**, **0.00% error rate**, **1,286 ms**, **FAIL**).
- If Ramp-down is 'none' or empty, simply do not mention ramp-down at all (never write 'without ramp-down').
- Keep each paragraph to 2–3 clear sentences.
- Output exactly two paragraphs followed by 'Next steps:' and three plain-English bullet points (do NOT put bracketed tags like [Root cause] or [Remediation] at the start of bullets).

Test Results:
Application : {app_names} ({env})
Test Type   : {test_type}
Workload    : {vu_actual} virtual users ({duration_desc})
Throughput  : {throughput} TPS
Error Rate  : {error_rate}%
Latency     : {latency} ms ({baseline_comp})
Status      : {overall_status}
Breaches    : {breach_cnt} ({rt_metric}) — slowest transaction: {worst_label} at {worst_rt} ms vs {worst_sla} ms target
Main Flows  : {flow_theme}

Structure:
PARAGRAPH 1: Explain how the test ran—how many virtual users it handled, the ramp-up and steady-state profile, the average throughput and error rate, and how overall response time compared to the baseline run.
PARAGRAPH 2: Explain how transactions performed against the response time target, naming the slowest transaction if any exceeded the limit. State the overall outcome clearly and close with a helpful, practical recommendation on what to review before the next run.
Next steps:
- First bullet: Which slow transaction or area to investigate first (bold the transaction name).
- Second bullet: What practical tuning or fix to look into.
- Third bullet: Re-running the test under the same load to confirm the fix worked."
  }

  template_vars <- list(
    app_names       = app_names_str,
    env             = env_str,
    test_type       = test_type_str,
    vu_actual       = as.character(vu_actual),
    duration_desc   = duration_desc,
    ramp_up         = val_ramp_up,
    steady_state    = val_steady_state,
    ramp_down       = ifelse(nzchar(val_ramp_down), val_ramp_down, "none"),
    throughput      = sprintf("%.2f", current_run$throughput[1]),
    error_rate      = sprintf("%.2f", current_run$error_rate[1]),
    latency         = current_rt_fmt,
    current_rt      = current_rt_fmt,
    rt_metric       = rt_metric_name,
    baseline_run_id = as.character(baseline_run_id),
    baseline_comp   = sprintf("%s vs Baseline #%s: %s", rt_metric_name, baseline_run_id, rt_comp_str),
    overall_status  = if (!isTRUE(show_overall_status)) "INFORMATIONAL (Do NOT state PASS or FAIL; describe the findings in plain English)" else ifelse(isTRUE(overall_status), "PASS", "FAIL"),
    breach_cnt      = as.character(breach_cnt),
    worst_label     = worst_label,
    worst_rt        = as.character(worst_rt),
    worst_sla       = as.character(worst_sla),
    flow_theme      = flow_theme
  )

  ai_prompt <- prompt_template
  for (var_name in names(template_vars)) {
    ai_prompt <- gsub(paste0("{", var_name, "}"), template_vars[[var_name]], ai_prompt, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  if (!isTRUE(show_overall_status) || !isTRUE(any_sla_enabled)) {
    extra_note <- if (!isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
      sprintf(
        "\n\nIMPORTANT NOTE: All SLA thresholds and overall PASS/FAIL verdicts are disabled for this report. Do NOT mention SLA breaches, SLA targets, or the words 'PASS' or 'FAIL'. In Paragraph 2, simply highlight that the slowest transaction was **%s** at **%s ms** (%s) and suggest reviewing the slower %s if further speed improvements are needed.",
        worst_label, worst_rt, rt_metric_name, flow_theme
      )
    } else {
      "\n\nIMPORTANT NOTE: This report is in Informational Mode (show_overall_status = false). Do NOT use the words 'PASS' or 'FAIL' or talk about release gating. Simply explain how the system performed and which slow transactions are worth looking into."
    }
    ai_prompt <- paste0(ai_prompt, extra_note)
  }

  ai_text <- tryCatch({
    ai_url <- if (exists("params_cfg") && !is.null(params_cfg$ai_url)) params_cfg$ai_url else "https://amplify.planittesting.com/external/api/completion"
    ai_model <- if (exists("params_cfg") && !is.null(params_cfg$ai_model_id)) params_cfg$ai_model_id else "19b89d52-23cf-463d-a5bb-c2896a0f8661"

    resp_text <- NULL
    if (requireNamespace("httr", quietly = TRUE)) {
      resp <- httr::POST(
        url = ai_url,
        httr::add_headers("accept" = "*/*", "token" = api_key, "Content-Type" = "application/json"),
        body = jsonlite::toJSON(list(
          model_id   = ai_model,
          messages   = list(list(role = "user", content = ai_prompt)),
          parameters = list(temperature = 0.3)
        ), auto_unbox = TRUE),
        encode = "json",
        httr::timeout(35)
      )
      if (httr::status_code(resp) == 200) {
        parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
        if (!is.null(parsed$assistant_resp) &&
            nchar(trimws(parsed$assistant_resp)) > 30 &&
            !grepl("^\\s*(unauthorized|error\\b|invalid\\s*token)", tolower(parsed$assistant_resp), perl = TRUE)) {
          resp_text <- parsed$assistant_resp
        }
      }
    }
    resp_text
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (!is.null(ai_text) && nzchar(ai_text)) {
    if (grepl("---", ai_text)) {
      ai_text <- trimws(tail(strsplit(ai_text, "---")[[1]], n = 1))
    }

    clean_p <- function(p) {
      trimws(sub("^(?i)(PARAGRAPH\\s*\\d*[:.\\-—\\s]*(What happened|Context|Verdict)?[:.\\-—\\s]*|Context[:.\\-—\\s]*|Verdict[:.\\-—\\s]*)\\s*", "", p, perl = TRUE))
    }
    clean_bullet <- function(b) {
      b <- trimws(sub("^([-*•]|\\d+[.)])?\\s*(Step\\s*\\d+[:\\s-]*|First bullet[:\\s-]*|Second bullet[:\\s-]*|Third bullet[:\\s-]*|\\d+[:.)]\\s*)?", "", b, perl = TRUE))
      trimws(sub("^\\*\\*\\[(Root cause|Remediation|Retest)\\]\\*\\*\\s*|^\\[(Root cause|Remediation|Retest)\\]\\s*", "", b, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE))
    }

    # Separate narrative paragraphs from next steps section
    narrative_text <- ai_text
    bullets_text <- ""

    if (grepl("(?i)\n\\s*(Next steps|Recommended actions|Key actions)[:\\s]*", ai_text, perl = TRUE)) {
      secs <- strsplit(ai_text, "(?i)\n\\s*(Next steps|Recommended actions|Key actions)[:\\s]*", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
      narrative_text <- secs[1]
      bullets_text <- paste(secs[-1], collapse = "\n")
    } else {
      raw_lines <- unlist(strsplit(ai_text, "\r?\n"))
      first_b_idx <- which(grepl("^\\s*[-*•]|^(?i)\\s*step\\s*\\d+|\\b\\d+[.)]\\s+", raw_lines, perl = TRUE))[1]
      if (!is.na(first_b_idx) && first_b_idx > 1) {
        narrative_text <- paste(raw_lines[1:(first_b_idx - 1)], collapse = "\n")
        bullets_text <- paste(raw_lines[first_b_idx:length(raw_lines)], collapse = "\n")
      }
    }

    # Extract paragraphs
    p_parts <- strsplit(trimws(narrative_text), "\n\n+")[[1]]
    p_paras <- sapply(p_parts, clean_p, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    p_paras <- p_paras[nzchar(p_paras)]

    if (length(p_paras) >= 2) {
      final_p1 <- p_paras[1]
      final_p2 <- p_paras[2]
    } else if (length(p_paras) == 1) {
      final_p1 <- p_paras[1]
    }

    # Extract bullets
    b_lines <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(bullets_text, "\r?\n")))
    b_matched <- grep("^[-*•]|^(?i)step\\s*\\d+|\\b\\d+[.)]\\s*", b_lines, perl = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    b_cleaned <- sapply(b_matched, clean_bullet, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    b_cleaned <- b_cleaned[nzchar(b_cleaned)]

    if (length(b_cleaned) >= 2) {
      final_next_steps <- b_cleaned
    }
  }
}

to_html_bold <- function(x) {
  gsub("\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", x)
}

app_rows_html <- paste(

    r <- app_health[i, ]

    status_td <- if (show_status_cols) {
      status_badge_inner <- if (isTRUE(r$application_pass)) {

        "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
      }
      sprintf(

        app_id_safe,
        status_badge_inner
      )
    } else ""

    tx_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$transactions, r$base_tx, lower_is_better = FALSE)
    tp_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$throughput, r$base_throughput, lower_is_better = FALSE)
    rt_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$pct_rt, r$base_pct_rt, lower_is_better = TRUE)
    er_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$error_rate, r$base_error_rate, lower_is_better = TRUE)

    tp_cell <- paste0(metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f TPS", r$throughput), r$throughput_pass, enabled = tps_sla_enabled), tp_delta_html)
    rt_cell <- paste0(
      metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(r$pct_rt), big.mark = ",")), r$scenario_pass, enabled = rt_sla_enabled),
      rt_delta_html,
      if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled) && !is.na(r$logical_failed) && r$logical_failed > 0) {
        sprintf(" <span style='font-size:10px;color:#DC2626;font-weight:600;'>(%d scenario breach%s)</span>",
                r$logical_failed, ifelse(r$logical_failed > 1, "es", ""))
      } else ""
    )
    er_cell <- paste0(metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f%%", r$error_rate), r$error_pass, enabled = er_sla_enabled), er_delta_html)

    scen_btn_inner <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
      metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", r$logical_passed, r$logical_total), r$scenario_pass, enabled = rt_sla_enabled)
    } else {
      sprintf("<span style='font-weight:600;'>%d Scenario%s</span>", r$logical_total, ifelse(r$logical_total == 1, "", "s"))
    }
    scen_btn <- sprintf(

      app_id_safe,
      scen_btn_inner
    )

    sprintf(
      "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='scenario' data-open-tab='%s'>
         <td style='font-weight:700;'>%s</td>
         %s
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td>
       </tr>",
      app_id_safe,
      r$app_name,
      status_td,
      format(r$transactions, big.mark = ","), tx_delta_html,
      tp_cell,
      rt_cell,
      er_cell,
      scen_btn
    )
  }),
  collapse = "\n"
)

# Right Table: Top Response Time Breaches (when RT SLA is enabled) OR Top Slowest Transactions (when RT SLA is disabled)
label_to_logical <- cur_scen_map %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(logical_scenario = first(logical_scenario), .groups = "drop")

right_breach_card_html <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
  breach_rows_html <- ""
  breach_badge_html <- "<label for='hd-mode-charts' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='charts' data-open-tab='DISTRIBUTION' style='margin:0;'>⭐ Apdex Experience</label> <span class='status-pass'>0 Breaches</span>"

  if (!is.null(rt_summary) && rt_summary$failed_count > 0 && nrow(rt_summary$top_breaches) > 0) {
    breach_badge_html <- sprintf(
      "<label for='hd-mode-charts' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='charts' data-open-tab='DISTRIBUTION' style='margin:0;'>⭐ Apdex Experience</label> <label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='BREACHES' style='margin:0;'><span class='status-fail'>Top %d of %d Breaches</span> 🔍</label>",
      nrow(rt_summary$top_breaches), rt_summary$failed_count
    )

    top_b_df <- rt_summary$top_breaches %>%
      left_join(label_to_logical, by = "label")

    max_breach_pct <- max(top_b_df$breach_pct, 1, na.rm = TRUE)

    breach_rows_html <- paste(
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(top_b_df)), function(i) {
        b <- top_b_df[i, ]
        scen_short <- ifelse(is.na(b$logical_scenario), "-", b$logical_scenario)
        scen_id_safe <- if (scen_short != "-") safe_dom_id(scen_short) else "BREACHES"
        bar_w <- max(min(round((b$breach_pct / max_breach_pct) * 100, 0), 100), 8)
        sprintf(
          "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s'>
             <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s <span style='color:#64748B;font-weight:400;font-size:10px;'>[%s]</span></td>
             <td class='numeric-cell'><span class='status-fail'>%s ms</span></td>
             <td class='numeric-cell' style='color:#64748B;'>%s ms</td>
             <td class='numeric-cell'>
               <div class='hd-microbar-cell'>
                 <span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-fail'>▲ +%s%%</span>
                 <div class='hd-microbar-track'><div class='hd-microbar-fill danger' style='width:%d%%;'></div></div>
               </div>
             </td>
           </tr>",
          scen_id_safe,
          b$label,
          scen_short,
          format(round(b$actual_rt), big.mark = ","),
          format(round(b$threshold), big.mark = ","),
          format(b$breach_pct, nsmall = 1),
          bar_w
        )
      }),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  } else {
    breach_rows_html <- "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center;color:#16A34A;font-weight:600;padding:12px;'>✓ All transactions satisfied Response Time SLA thresholds.</td></tr>"
  }

  sprintf(
    '<div class="hd-card">
       <div class="hd-card-header">
         <h3 class="hd-card-title">🔥 Top Response Time Breaches <span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;color:#64748B;text-transform:none;">(%s vs Threshold — Click to View All)</span></h3>
         <div class="hd-card-badges">%s</div>
       </div>
       <div class="hd-table-scroll">
         <table class="hd-table">
           <thead>
             <tr>
               <th>Transaction [Scenario]</th>
               <th class="numeric-header">Actual (%s)</th>
               <th class="numeric-header">SLA</th>
               <th class="numeric-header">Impact</th>
             </tr>
           </thead>
           <tbody>
             %s
           </tbody>
         </table>
       </div>
     </div>',
    rt_metric_name,
    breach_badge_html,
    rt_metric_name,
    breach_rows_html
  )
} else {
  slow_df <- joined_labels_all %>%
    arrange(desc(actual_rt)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  max_slow_rt <- if (nrow(slow_df) > 0) max(slow_df$actual_rt, 1, na.rm = TRUE) else 1

  slow_badge_html <- sprintf(
    "<label for='hd-mode-charts' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='charts' data-open-tab='DISTRIBUTION' style='margin:0;'>⭐ Apdex Experience</label> <label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='ALL' style='margin:0;'><span class='total-app'>Top %d of %d Slowest</span> 🔍</label>",
    nrow(slow_df), nrow(joined_labels_all)
  )

  slow_rows_html <- if (nrow(slow_df) > 0) {
    paste(
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(slow_df)), function(i) {
        b <- slow_df[i, ]
        scen_short <- ifelse(is.na(b$logical_scenario), "-", b$logical_scenario)
        scen_id_safe <- if (scen_short != "-") safe_dom_id(scen_short) else "ALL"
        bar_w <- max(min(round((b$actual_rt / max_slow_rt) * 100, 0), 100), 8)
        req_str <- if (!is.na(b$tx_count)) format(b$tx_count, big.mark = ",") else "—"
        err_str <- if (!is.na(b$error_rate)) sprintf("%.2f%%", b$error_rate) else "0.00%"
        sprintf(
          "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s'>
             <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s <span style='color:#64748B;font-weight:400;font-size:10px;'>[%s]</span></td>
             <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
             <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
             <td class='numeric-cell'>
               <div class='hd-microbar-cell'>
                 <span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:#2563EB;'>%s ms</span>
                 <div class='hd-microbar-track'><div class='hd-microbar-fill' style='width:%d%%;background:linear-gradient(90deg, #60A5FA 0%%, #2563EB 100%%);'></div></div>
               </div>
             </td>

          b$label,
          scen_short,
          req_str,
          err_str,
          format(round(b$actual_rt), big.mark = ","),
          bar_w
        )
      }),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  } else {
    "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center;color:#64748B;font-weight:600;padding:12px;'>No transaction latency data available.</td></tr>"
  }

  sprintf(
    '<div class="hd-card">
       <div class="hd-card-header">
         <h3 class="hd-card-title">⏱️ Top Slowest Transactions <span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;color:#64748B;text-transform:none;">(Highest %s Response Time — Click to View All)</span></h3>
         <div class="hd-card-badges">%s</div>
       </div>

           <thead>

             %s

         </table>
       </div>
     </div>',
    rt_metric_name,
    slow_badge_html,
    rt_metric_name,
    slow_rows_html
  )
}

calc_tps_pass_rate <- function(target_rid) {
  sub_apps <- db_app_summary %>% filter(run_id == target_rid)
  if (nrow(sub_apps) == 0) return(NA)
  passed <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(sub_apps)), function(i) sub_apps$throughput[i] >= get_app_tps_threshold(sub_apps$app_name[i]))
  round(sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(sub_apps) * 100, 2)
}

calc_err_pass_rate <- function(target_rid) {
  sub_scens <- db_scenario_summary %>% filter(run_id == target_rid)
  if (nrow(sub_scens) == 0) return(NA)
  passed <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(sub_scens)), function(i) sub_scens$error_rate[i] <= get_app_error_threshold(sub_scens$app_name[i]))
  round(sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(sub_scens) * 100, 2)
}

# ---- 8.0 Build Lightweight Pure-SVG Executive Charts ----
ts_cur  <- if (exists("db_timeseries")) db_timeseries %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>% arrange(elapsed_min) else tibble()
ts_base <- if (exists("db_timeseries")) db_timeseries %>% filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>% arrange(elapsed_min) else tibble()

build_svg_dual_line_chart <- function(cur_df, base_df, y_col, y_label, unit_str = "",
                                      cur_color = "#2563EB", base_color = "#64748B",
                                      ref_val = NULL, ref_label = NULL,
                                      sec_col = NULL, sec_label = NULL,
                                      svg_w = 520, svg_h = 195) {
  if (nrow(cur_df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:11px;padding:12px;'>No time-series data available.</p>")
  }
  pad_l <- 46; pad_r <- if (!is.null(sec_col)) 42 else 18; pad_t <- 16; pad_b <- 26
  plot_w <- svg_w - pad_l - pad_r
  plot_h <- svg_h - pad_t - pad_b

  max_x <- max(c(cur_df$elapsed_min, if (nrow(base_df) > 0) base_df$elapsed_min else 1, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  all_y <- c(cur_df[[y_col]], if (nrow(base_df) > 0) base_df[[y_col]] else numeric(0), if (!is.null(ref_val)) ref_val else numeric(0))
  max_y <- max(c(all_y * 1.12, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

  scale_x <- function(x) round(pad_l + (x / max_x) * plot_w, 1)
  scale_y <- function(y) round(pad_t + plot_h - (pmin(pmax(y, 0), max_y) / max_y) * plot_h, 1)

  # Horizontal gridlines & Y ticks (4 steps)
  y_ticks <- seq(0, max_y, length.out = 5)
  grid_svg <- paste(sapply(y_ticks, function(yv) {
    yp <- scale_y(yv)
    lbl <- if (yv >= 1000) format(round(yv, 0), big.mark = ",") else round(yv, 1)
    sprintf(
      "<line x1='%d' y1='%s' x2='%d' y2='%s' stroke='#F1F5F9' stroke-width='1'/><text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='end' fill='#64748B' font-size='9.5' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%s</text>",
      pad_l, yp, pad_l + plot_w, yp, pad_l - 5, yp + 3, lbl
    )
  }), collapse = "")

  # X-axis ticks
  x_ticks <- unique(round(seq(0, max_x, length.out = 6)))
  x_svg <- paste(sapply(x_ticks, function(xv) {
    xp <- scale_x(xv)
    sprintf(
      "<line x1='%s' y1='%d' x2='%s' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/><text x='%s' y='%d' text-anchor='middle' fill='#64748B' font-size='9.5' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%dm</text>",
      xp, pad_t + plot_h, xp, pad_t + plot_h + 4, xp, pad_t + plot_h + 15, xv
    )
  }), collapse = "")

  # Optional secondary backdrop area (e.g. Active Users)
  sec_svg <- ""
  if (!is.null(sec_col) && sec_col %in% names(cur_df)) {
    max_sec <- max(c(cur_df[[sec_col]] * 1.15, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    scale_sec_y <- function(y) round(pad_t + plot_h - (pmin(pmax(y, 0), max_sec) / max_sec) * plot_h, 1)
    pts_sec <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(cur_df$elapsed_min), scale_sec_y(cur_df[[sec_col]])), collapse = " ")
    poly_sec <- sprintf("%s,%d %s %s,%d", scale_x(min(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h, pts_sec, scale_x(max(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h)
    sec_ticks <- seq(0, max_sec, length.out = 3)
    sec_axis <- paste(sapply(sec_ticks, function(sv) {
      yp <- scale_sec_y(sv)
      sprintf("<text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='start' fill='#6366F1' font-size='9' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%d VU</text>",
              pad_l + plot_w + 4, yp + 3, round(sv))
    }), collapse = "")
    sec_svg <- sprintf("<polygon points='%s' fill='#EEF2FF' opacity='0.75'/><polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='#A5B4FC' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>%s",
                       poly_sec, pts_sec, sec_axis)
  }

  # Baseline polyline
  base_svg <- ""
  if (nrow(base_df) > 0 && has_baseline) {
    pts_b <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(base_df$elapsed_min), scale_y(base_df[[y_col]])), collapse = " ")
    base_svg <- sprintf("<polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='%s' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-dasharray='4,3' opacity='0.85'/>", pts_b, base_color)
  }

  # Current area + polyline
  pts_c <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(cur_df$elapsed_min), scale_y(cur_df[[y_col]])), collapse = " ")
  poly_c <- sprintf("%s,%d %s %s,%d", scale_x(min(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h, pts_c, scale_x(max(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h)
  cur_svg <- sprintf(
    "<polygon points='%s' fill='%s' opacity='0.10'/><polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='%s' stroke-width='2.2'/>",
    poly_c, cur_color, pts_c, cur_color
  )

  # Optional SLA reference line
  ref_svg <- ""
  if (!is.null(ref_val) && !is.na(ref_val) && ref_val > 0 && ref_val <= max_y) {
    ry <- scale_y(ref_val)
    ref_svg <- sprintf(
      "<line x1='%d' y1='%s' x2='%d' y2='%s' stroke='#DC2626' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-dasharray='5,3'/><text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='end' fill='#DC2626' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%s</text>",
      pad_l, ry, pad_l + plot_w, ry, pad_l + plot_w - 4, max(ry - 4, pad_t + 8), ifelse(is.null(ref_label), "SLA", ref_label)
    )
  }

  sprintf(
    "<svg viewBox='0 0 %d %d' style='width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible;'>
       %s
       %s
       <line x1='%d' y1='%d' x2='%d' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/>
       <line x1='%d' y1='%d' x2='%d' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/>
       %s
       %s
       %s
       %s
     </svg>",
    svg_w, svg_h,
    grid_svg,
    sec_svg,
    pad_l, pad_t, pad_l, pad_t + plot_h,
    pad_l, pad_t + plot_h, pad_l + plot_w, pad_t + plot_h,
    x_svg,
    base_svg,
    cur_svg,
    ref_svg
  )
}

get_ts_sub <- function(df, target_app) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  if (!"app_name" %in% names(df)) return(df)
  if (target_app == "ALL") {
    sub <- df %>% filter(app_name == "ALL")
    if (nrow(sub) > 0) return(sub)
    return(df)
  }
  df %>% filter(app_name == target_app)
}

# Chart 3: Scenario P95 Response Time: Current vs Baseline (Stacked by Transaction + Clickable Scenario Modal)
base_scen_df <- db_logical_scenario_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  select(app_name, logical_scenario, base_pct_rt = pct_rt, base_tps = throughput, base_req = requests)

# Prepare per-scenario label breakdown for Current and Baseline runs
base_scen_map <- db_label_scen_map %>% filter(run_id == baseline_run_id)
base_labels_by_scen <- db_label_rt %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  inner_join(base_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
  distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, base_rt = actual_rt, base_tx_count = tx_count)

cur_labels_by_scen <- if (nrow(joined_labels_all) > 0) {
  joined_labels_all
} else {
  db_label_rt %>%
    filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
    inner_join(cur_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
    mutate(
      threshold  = rt_default,
      passed     = actual_rt <= rt_default,
      breach_pct = round(((actual_rt - rt_default) / rt_default) * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, actual_rt, threshold, passed, breach_pct, tx_count, errors, error_rate)
}

scen_tx_totals_cur <- cur_labels_by_scen %>%
  group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
  summarise(total_cur_rt = sum(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

scen_tx_totals_base <- base_labels_by_scen %>%
  group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
  summarise(total_base_rt = sum(base_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

scen_comp_df <- logical_health_df %>%
  left_join(base_scen_df, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  left_join(scen_tx_totals_cur, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  left_join(scen_tx_totals_base, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cur_rt  = ifelse(is.na(total_cur_rt) | total_cur_rt <= 0, pct_rt, total_cur_rt),
    total_base_rt = ifelse(is.na(total_base_rt) | total_base_rt <= 0, ifelse(is.na(base_pct_rt), 0, base_pct_rt), total_base_rt)
  )

max_scen_rt <- max(c(scen_comp_df$total_cur_rt, scen_comp_df$total_base_rt, 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08

tx_palette <- c(
  "#2563EB", "#7C3AED", "#DB2777", "#D97706", "#059669",
  "#0891B2", "#4F46E5", "#EA580C", "#0D9488", "#9333EA",
  "#0284C7", "#65A30D", "#E11D48", "#CA8A04", "#10B981",

scen_bars_html <- paste(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(scen_comp_df)), function(i) {
    s <- scen_comp_df[i, ]
    drill_id <- scen_drill_ids[i]

    # Fetch all transactions belonging to this scenario
    scen_tx_df <- cur_labels_by_scen %>%
      filter(app_name == s$app_name, logical_scenario == s$logical_scenario) %>%
      full_join(
        base_labels_by_scen %>% filter(app_name == s$app_name, logical_scenario == s$logical_scenario),
        by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario", "label")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        actual_rt  = ifelse(is.na(actual_rt), 0, actual_rt),
        base_rt    = ifelse(is.na(base_rt), 0, base_rt),
        threshold  = ifelse(is.na(threshold), rt_default, threshold),
        passed     = ifelse(is.na(passed), actual_rt <= threshold, passed),
        tx_count   = ifelse(is.na(tx_count), 0L, as.integer(tx_count))
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(actual_rt), label)

    n_tx <- nrow(scen_tx_df)
    if (n_tx > 0) {
      scen_tx_df$tx_color <- tx_palette[((seq_len(n_tx) - 1) %% length(tx_palette)) + 1]
    }

    total_cur_v  <- if (n_tx > 0) sum(scen_tx_df$actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else s$total_cur_rt
    total_base_v <- if (n_tx > 0) sum(scen_tx_df$base_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else s$total_base_rt
    sum_cur_rt   <- max(total_cur_v, 1)
    sum_base_rt  <- max(total_base_v, 1)

    cur_w   <- max(round((total_cur_v / max_scen_rt) * 100, 1), 2)
    base_w  <- max(round((total_base_v / max_scen_rt) * 100, 1), 2)
    delta_b <- inline_delta_badge(total_cur_v, total_base_v, lower_is_better = TRUE)

    base_segments_html <- if (n_tx > 0) {

    # Build the per-scenario Transaction P95 SLA Breakdown chart for the secondary modal

                 <div style='position:absolute;left:%s%%;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1.5px dashed #DC2626;z-index:2;' title='SLA Threshold: %s ms'></div>

                   <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#334155;width:48px;'>Current</span>
                   <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:8px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;'>
                     <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;background:%s;border-radius:3px;'></div>
                   </div>
                 </div>
                 <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
                   <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;color:#64748B;width:48px;'>Baseline</span>
                   <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;'>
                     <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;background:#64748B;border-radius:3px;'></div>
                   </div>
                 </div>
               </div>
             </div>",
            tx$tx_color,
            htmlEscape(tx$label), format(tx$tx_count, big.mark = ","), format(round(tx$threshold), big.mark = ","),
            tx_cur_col, format(round(tx$actual_rt), big.mark = ","), format(round(tx$base_rt), big.mark = ","), tx_delta_b, tx_status_pill,
            tx_sla_pos, format(round(tx$threshold), big.mark = ","),
            tx_cur_w, tx_cur_col,
            tx_base_w
          )
        }),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    } else {
      "<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:12px;'>No transactions found for this scenario.</p>"
    }

    scen_drill_panels_list[i] <<- sprintf(
      '<div id="scen-tx-panel-%s" class="hd-scen-tx-panel">
         <div class="hd-scen-tx-panel-summary">
           <div>
             <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;font-family:Consolas,monospace;">🧭 %s</span>
             <span style="font-size:11px;color:#64748B;margin-left:8px;">(%d of %d transactions passed SLA &le; %s ms &bull; Total %s: %s ms vs %s ms Base)</span>

             <span><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;border-top:2px dashed #DC2626;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;"></span>SLA (%s ms)</span>
           </div>
         </div>
         <div style="padding-top:8px;">%s</div>
       </div>',
      drill_id,
      htmlEscape(s$logical_scenario),

      rt_metric_name, format(round(total_cur_v), big.mark = ","), format(round(total_base_v), big.mark = ","),

    sprintf(

           <span><strong style='color:#0F172A;'>Total %s: %s ms</strong> vs <span style='color:#64748B;'>%s ms Base</span> %s</span>
         </div>
         <div class='hd-scen-stack-track-box' style='position:relative;background:#F1F5F9;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;'>
           <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
             <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#334155;width:48px;'>Current</span>
             <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:10px;border-radius:3px;position:relative;'>

             <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;color:#64748B;width:48px;'>Baseline</span>
             <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:8px;border-radius:3px;position:relative;'>
               <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;display:flex;border-radius:3px;'>%s</div>

       </label>",

      cur_w, cur_segments_html,

  collapse = "\n"

# Chart 4: Error Timeline (Errors/Min) & Top Failing Transactions Pareto
render_pareto_bars <- function(target_app = "ALL") {
  df <- if (target_app == "ALL") {
    error_summary_cur
  } else {
    error_summary_cur %>% filter(app_name == target_app)
  }
  tot_app_err <- sum(df$errors, na.rm = TRUE)
  top5 <- df %>% slice_head(n = 5)
  if (nrow(top5) == 0 || tot_app_err == 0) {
    return("<div style='color:#16A34A;font-size:11px;padding:6px 0;'>✓ Zero transaction errors recorded.</div>")
  }
  top5 <- top5 %>%
    mutate(
      share_pct = round((errors / tot_app_err) * 100, 1),
      cum_pct   = round(cumsum(share_pct), 1)
    )
  paste(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(top5)), function(i) {
      p <- top5[i, ]
      sprintf(
        "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;margin-bottom:3px;'>
           <span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:600;color:#1E293B;width:210px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;' title='%s'>%s</span>
           <div style='flex:1;background:#F1F5F9;height:7px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;'>
             <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;background:#DC2626;border-radius:3px;'></div>
           </div>
           <span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:#DC2626;width:95px;text-align:right;'>%s (%s%% | Σ%s%%)</span>
         </div>",
        htmlEscape(p$label), htmlEscape(p$label), p$share_pct, format(p$errors, big.mark = ","), p$share_pct, p$cum_pct
      )
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

chart4_pareto_panels[["ALL"]] <- sprintf(
  '<div class="hd-chart-app-panel hd-chart-app-ALL">%s</div>',
  render_pareto_bars("ALL")
)

for (app in unique_charts_apps) {

    '<div class="hd-chart-app-panel hd-chart-app-%s">%s</div>',

    render_pareto_bars(app)

}

# Chart 5: Apdex User Experience & Performance Index (Current vs Baseline)
render_apdex_panel <- function(target_app = "ALL") {
  df <- if (exists("db_apdex")) db_apdex else if (exists("db_latency_bands")) db_latency_bands else tibble()
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:11px;padding:12px;'>No Apdex performance data available.</p>")
  }

  cur_band <- df %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id, app_name == target_app)
  base_band <- if (has_baseline) df %>% filter(run_id == baseline_run_id, app_name == target_app) else tibble()

  cur_tot <- if (nrow(cur_band) > 0) cur_band$total_tx[1] else 0
  base_tot <- if (nrow(base_band) > 0) base_band$total_tx[1] else 0

  if (cur_tot == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:11px;padding:12px;'>No transactions recorded for this application.</p>")
  }

  cur_sat <- cur_band$satisfied[1]
  cur_tol <- cur_band$tolerating[1]
  cur_fru <- cur_band$frustrated[1]
  cur_score <- cur_band$apdex_score[1]

  cur_sat_pct <- round((cur_sat / cur_tot) * 100, 1)
  cur_tol_pct <- round((cur_tol / cur_tot) * 100, 1)
  cur_fru_pct <- round((cur_fru / cur_tot) * 100, 1)

  base_sat <- if (base_tot > 0) base_band$satisfied[1] else 0
  base_tol <- if (base_tot > 0) base_band$tolerating[1] else 0
  base_fru <- if (base_tot > 0) base_band$frustrated[1] else 0
  base_score <- if (base_tot > 0) base_band$apdex_score[1] else 0

  base_sat_pct <- if (base_tot > 0) round((base_sat / base_tot) * 100, 1) else 0
  base_tol_pct <- if (base_tot > 0) round((base_tol / base_tot) * 100, 1) else 0
  base_fru_pct <- if (base_tot > 0) round((base_fru / base_tot) * 100, 1) else 0

  # Helper for Apdex rating label and colors
  get_apdex_rating <- function(score) {
    if (score >= 0.94) return(list(rating = "Excellent", color = "#16A34A", bg = "#DCFCE7"))
    if (score >= 0.85) return(list(rating = "Good", color = "#2563EB", bg = "#DBEAFE"))
    if (score >= 0.70) return(list(rating = "Fair", color = "#D97706", bg = "#FEF3C7"))
    if (score >= 0.50) return(list(rating = "Poor", color = "#EA580C", bg = "#FFEDD5"))
    return(list(rating = "Unacceptable", color = "#DC2626", bg = "#FEE2E2"))
  }

  cur_rate <- get_apdex_rating(cur_score)
  base_rate <- if (base_tot > 0) get_apdex_rating(base_score) else NULL

  # Horizontal Stacked Experience Bar
  build_apdex_bar <- function(sat_p, tol_p, fru_p, is_base = FALSE) {
    op <- if (is_base) "opacity:0.85;border-top:1px dashed #64748B;" else ""
    segs <- c()
    if (sat_p > 0) {
      lbl <- if (sat_p >= 8) sprintf("<span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;'>%.1f%%</span>", sat_p) else ""
      segs <- c(segs, sprintf("<div style='width:%.2f%%;background:#16A34A;height:100%%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;%s' title='Satisfied (&le; T): %.1f%%'>%s</div>", sat_p, op, sat_p, lbl))
    }
    if (tol_p > 0) {
      lbl <- if (tol_p >= 8) sprintf("<span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;'>%.1f%%</span>", tol_p) else ""
      segs <- c(segs, sprintf("<div style='width:%.2f%%;background:#D97706;height:100%%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;%s' title='Tolerating (T to 4T): %.1f%%'>%s</div>", tol_p, op, tol_p, lbl))
    }
    if (fru_p > 0) {
      lbl <- if (fru_p >= 8) sprintf("<span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;'>%.1f%%</span>", fru_p) else ""
      segs <- c(segs, sprintf("<div style='width:%.2f%%;background:#DC2626;height:100%%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;%s' title='Frustrated (&gt; 4T or Error): %.1f%%'>%s</div>", fru_p, op, fru_p, lbl))
    }
    paste(segs, collapse = "")
  }

  cur_stack_html <- build_apdex_bar(cur_sat_pct, cur_tol_pct, cur_fru_pct, is_base = FALSE)
  base_stack_html <- if (base_tot > 0) build_apdex_bar(base_sat_pct, base_tol_pct, base_fru_pct, is_base = TRUE) else ""

  base_bar_block <- if (base_tot > 0) {
    sprintf(
      "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:5px;'>
         <span style='font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#64748B;width:58px;'>Baseline</span>
         <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:16px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;'>%s</div>
         <span style='font-size:10px;font-family:Consolas,monospace;color:#64748B;width:65px;text-align:right;'>%s tx</span>
       </div>",
      base_stack_html, format(base_tot, big.mark = ",")
    )
  } else ""

  # Table breakdown rows for the 3 Apdex zones
  tiers <- list(
    list(name = "Satisfied (&le; T)", desc = "Instant / Responsive", color = "#16A34A", cur_cnt = cur_sat, cur_pct = cur_sat_pct, base_cnt = base_sat, base_pct = base_sat_pct, lower_is_better = FALSE),
    list(name = "Tolerating (T to 4T)", desc = "Noticeable Delay", color = "#D97706", cur_cnt = cur_tol, cur_pct = cur_tol_pct, base_cnt = base_tol, base_pct = base_tol_pct, lower_is_better = TRUE),
    list(name = "Frustrated (&gt; 4T / Error)", desc = "Severe Stall / Failed", color = "#DC2626", cur_cnt = cur_fru, cur_pct = cur_fru_pct, base_cnt = base_fru, base_pct = base_fru_pct, lower_is_better = TRUE)
  )

  table_rows <- paste(lapply(tiers, function(t) {
    delta_str <- if (base_tot > 0) {
      inline_delta_badge(t$cur_pct, t$base_pct, lower_is_better = t$lower_is_better)
    } else ""
    base_val_str <- if (base_tot > 0) sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", t$base_pct, format(t$base_cnt, big.mark = ",")) else "-"
    sprintf(
      "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F1F5F9;font-size:10.5px;'>
         <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
           <span style='display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:%s;'></span>
           <span style='color:#1E293B;font-weight:600;'>%s</span>
           <span style='color:#64748B;font-size:9.5px;'>(%s)</span>
         </div>
         <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:Consolas,monospace;'>
           <span style='color:#0F172A;font-weight:700;'>%.1f%% (%s)</span>
           <span style='color:#64748B;'>vs %s</span>
           <span style='min-width:55px;text-align:right;'>%s</span>
         </div>
       </div>",
      t$color, t$name, t$desc, t$cur_pct, format(t$cur_cnt, big.mark = ","), base_val_str, delta_str
    )
  }), collapse = "\n")

  score_badge_html <- sprintf(
    "<span style='background:%s;color:%s;font-weight:800;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-family:Consolas,monospace;'>Apdex %.2f (%s)</span>",
    cur_rate$bg, cur_rate$color, cur_score, cur_rate$rating
  )
  base_comp_html <- if (base_tot > 0) {
    sprintf("<span style='font-size:10px;color:#64748B;margin-left:6px;'>vs %.2f Base (%s) %s</span>",
            base_score, base_rate$rating, inline_delta_badge(cur_score, base_score, lower_is_better = FALSE))
  } else ""

  sprintf(
    "<div style='padding-top:4px;'>
       <div style='display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;'>
         <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;'>
           %s
           %s
         </div>
         <span style='font-size:10.5px;color:#64748B;'>Total Samples: <strong style='color:#0F172A;font-family:Consolas,monospace;'>%s</strong></span>
       </div>
       <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;'>
         <span style='font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;width:58px;'>Current</span>
         <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:18px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;'>%s</div>
         <span style='font-size:10px;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;width:65px;text-align:right;'>%s tx</span>
       </div>
       %s
       <div style='margin-top:8px;padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #E2E8F0;'>
         %s
       </div>
       <div style='margin-top:8px;padding:6px 9px;background:#F8FAFC;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;color:#475569;line-height:1.4;'>
         <div style='font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;margin-bottom:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;'>
           <span>💡 What is Apdex?</span>
           <label for='hd-mode-glossary' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='glossary' data-open-tab='LATENCY' style='margin:0;font-size:9.5px;padding:1px 6px;'>📖 Read in Glossary 🔍</label>
         </div>
         <strong>Apdex (Application Performance Index)</strong> is an open international standard (0.00 to 1.00) measuring user satisfaction. Each transaction is evaluated against its specific target threshold (<em>T</em>):
         <div style='margin-top:2px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;'>
           <span><strong style='color:#16A34A;'>🟢 Satisfied (&le; T):</strong> Fast &amp; productive</span>
           <span><strong style='color:#D97706;'>🟡 Tolerating (T to 4T):</strong> Slower, tolerated by user</span>
           <span><strong style='color:#DC2626;'>🔴 Frustrated (&gt; 4T or Error):</strong> Severe stall or failure</span>
         </div>
         <div style='margin-top:2px;color:#64748B;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:9.5px;'>
           Score = (Satisfied + 0.5 &times; Tolerating) / Total &bull; Ratings: &ge;0.94 Excellent | &ge;0.85 Good | &ge;0.70 Fair | &ge;0.50 Poor | &lt;0.50 Unacceptable
         </div>
       </div>
     </div>",
    score_badge_html, base_comp_html,
    format(cur_tot, big.mark = ","),
    cur_stack_html, format(cur_tot, big.mark = ","),
    base_bar_block,
    table_rows
  )
}

# ---- 8A. Build SLA Status Evaluation Summary Tables ----
render_modal_sla_table <- function(df, show_app_col = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#6c757d; padding:12px 0;'>No SLA evaluation data available.</p>")
  }
  rows_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    app_id_safe <- safe_dom_id(r$app_name)
    app_td <- if (show_app_col) sprintf("<td rowspan='4' style='font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle;border-right:1px solid #E2E8F0;'>%s</td>", r$app_name) else ""

    tp_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$throughput_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    er_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$error_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    sc_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$scenario_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    lb_passed   <- ifelse(is.na(r$breach_count), 0, r$breach_count) == 0
    lb_status_b <- if (lb_passed) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"

    tp_summary <- if (isTRUE(r$throughput_pass)) {
      sprintf("Achieved %.2f TPS against >= %.2f TPS target.", r$throughput, r$throughput_target)
    } else {
      sprintf("Below throughput target by %.2f TPS (Actual: %.2f TPS vs Target: >= %.2f TPS).", r$throughput_target - r$throughput, r$throughput, r$throughput_target)
    }

    app_err_tx_cnt <- nrow(error_summary_cur %>% filter(app_name == r$app_name))
    app_err_tot    <- sum((error_summary_cur %>% filter(app_name == r$app_name))$errors, na.rm = TRUE)
    er_summary <- sprintf(
      "%s total errors across %d failing transactions. <label for='hd-mode-error' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='error' data-open-tab='ALL' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect HTTP Errors 🔍</label>",
      format(app_err_tot, big.mark = ","), app_err_tx_cnt
    )

    sc_summary <- sprintf(
      "%d of %d scenarios passed %s Response Time SLA (%d failed). <label for='hd-mode-scenario' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='scenario' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect Scenarios 🔍</label>",
      r$logical_passed, r$logical_total, rt_metric_name, r$logical_failed, app_id_safe
    )

    tot_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$total_app_labels), 0L, r$total_app_labels)
    pas_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$passed_app_labels), 0L, r$passed_app_labels)
    brc_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$breach_count), 0L, r$breach_count)
    worst_str <- if (brc_lbl > 0 && !is.na(r$worst_label) && r$worst_label != "-") {
      sprintf("Worst breach: <code>%s</code> (%s ms vs %s ms SLA).",
              r$worst_label, format(round(r$worst_actual), big.mark = ","), format(round(r$worst_sla), big.mark = ","))
    } else {
      "All transactions met configured SLA thresholds."
    }
    lb_summary <- sprintf(
      "%d of %d transactions met SLA (%d breaches). %s <label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='BREACHES' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect Transactions 🔍</label>",
      pas_lbl, tot_lbl, brc_lbl, worst_str
    )

    paste0(
      sprintf(
        "<tr>%s<td style='font-weight:600;'>Throughput SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>&gt;= %.2f TPS</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f TPS %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        app_td, tp_status_b, r$throughput_target, r$throughput,
        inline_delta_badge(r$throughput, r$base_throughput, lower_is_better = FALSE), tp_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Error Rate SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>&lt;= %.2f%%</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f%% %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        er_status_b, r$error_target, r$error_rate,
        inline_delta_badge(r$error_rate, r$base_error_rate, lower_is_better = TRUE), er_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Scenario %s RT SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d of %d Scenarios</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s ms %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        rt_metric_name, sc_status_b, r$logical_total, r$logical_total,
        format(round(r$pct_rt), big.mark = ","),
        inline_delta_badge(r$pct_rt, r$base_pct_rt, lower_is_better = TRUE), sc_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Transaction %s RT SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d of %d Transactions</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d Passed / %d Breached</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        rt_metric_name, lb_status_b, tot_lbl, tot_lbl, pas_lbl, brc_lbl, lb_summary
      )
    )
  })

  app_th <- if (show_app_col) "<th>Application</th>" else ""
  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>SLA Dimension</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Status</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Target Threshold</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Actual (vs Base)</th>
          <th>Evaluation Details &amp; Action</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    app_th, paste(rows_list, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8B. Build Scenario Health Details Tables ----
render_modal_scenario_table <- function(df, show_app_col = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#6c757d; padding:12px 0;'>No scenario details available.</p>")
  }
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    scen_id_safe <- safe_dom_id(row$logical_scenario)
    status_td <- if (show_status_cols) {
      scen_status_badge <- if (isTRUE(row$scenario_passed)) "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
      sprintf("<td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td>", scen_status_badge)
    } else ""
    req_fmt   <- format(row$requests, big.mark = ",")
    tps_fmt   <- sprintf("%.2f TPS", row$throughput)
    p95_badge <- sprintf("<span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:600;'>%s ms</span>", format(round(row$pct_rt), big.mark = ","))

    lbl_text <- if (!is.na(row$total_labels) && row$total_labels > 0) {
      lbl_badge <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
        metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", row$passed_labels, row$total_labels), row$scenario_rt_passed, enabled = rt_sla_enabled)
      } else {
        sprintf("<span style='font-weight:600;'>%d Tx</span>", row$total_labels)
      }
      sprintf("<label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin:0;'>%s 🔍</label>", scen_id_safe, lbl_badge)
    } else "<span class='status-na'>N/A</span>"

    err_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f%%", row$error_rate), row$error_passed, enabled = er_sla_enabled)
    app_td    <- if (show_app_col) sprintf("<td><strong>%s</strong></td>", row$app_name) else ""

    sprintf(
      "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s'>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>%s<td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
      scen_id_safe, app_td, row$logical_scenario, status_td, req_fmt, tps_fmt, p95_badge, lbl_text, err_badge
    )
  })

  app_th    <- if (show_app_col) "<th>Application</th>" else ""
  status_th <- if (show_status_cols) "<th style='text-align:center;'>Status</th>" else ""
  tx_th     <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) "Transactions Met RT SLA" else "Transactions"
  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>Scenario</th>
          %s
          <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Avg. Throughput</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">%s</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">%s</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    app_th, status_th, rt_column_title, tx_th, paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
