      safe_id <- safe_dom_id(app)
      sub_df  <- scenario_health_df %>% filter(app_name == app)
      sprintf('<div id="scenario-data-%s" class="hd-tab-panel">%s</div>', safe_id, render_modal_scenario_table(sub_df, show_app_col = FALSE))
    })
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

# ---- 8C. Build Transactions Met SLA / Response Time Breakdown Tables ----
render_modal_label_table <- function(df, show_scen_col = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#16A34A; font-weight:600; padding:12px 0;'>✓ No breaching transactions in this view.</p>")
  }
  df_sorted <- if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
    df %>% arrange(passed, desc(breach_pct), desc(actual_rt))
  } else {
    df %>% arrange(desc(actual_rt))
  }
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df_sorted)), function(i) {
    r <- df_sorted[i, ]
    scen_td <- if (show_scen_col) sprintf("<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>", r$logical_scenario) else ""
    req_str <- if (!is.na(r$tx_count)) format(r$tx_count, big.mark = ",") else "—"
    err_str <- if (!is.na(r$error_rate)) sprintf("%.2f%%", r$error_rate) else "0.00%"

    if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
      st_td <- if (show_status_cols) {
        st_badge <- if (isTRUE(r$passed)) "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
        sprintf("<td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td>", st_badge)
      } else ""
      rt_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(r$actual_rt), big.mark = ",")), r$passed, enabled = rt_sla_enabled)
      variance_badge <- if (!isTRUE(r$passed)) {
        sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-fail'>▲ +%s%%</span>", format(r$breach_pct, nsmall = 1))
      } else {
        sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-pass'>▼ %s%%</span>", format(r$breach_pct, nsmall = 1))
      }
      sprintf(
        "<tr>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>%s<td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell' style='color:#64748B;'>%s ms</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
        scen_td, r$label, st_td, req_str, rt_badge,
        format(round(r$threshold), big.mark = ","),
        variance_badge, err_str
      )
    } else {
      rt_str <- sprintf("<span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:#2563EB;'>%s ms</span>", format(round(r$actual_rt), big.mark = ","))
      sprintf(
        "<tr>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
        scen_td, r$label, req_str, rt_str, err_str
      )
    }
  })

  scen_th <- if (show_scen_col) "<th>Scenario</th>" else ""
  if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) {
    st_th <- if (show_status_cols) "<th style='text-align:center;'>SLA Status</th>" else ""
    sprintf(
      '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            %s
            <th>Transaction</th>
            %s
            <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Actual (%s)</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">SLA Threshold</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Variance vs SLA</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>%s</tbody>
      </table>',
      scen_th, st_th, rt_metric_name, paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            %s
            <th>Transaction</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Actual (%s)</th>
            <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>%s</tbody>
      </table>',
      scen_th, rt_metric_name, paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
}

# ---- 8D. Build HTTP Error Codes & Error Messages Tables ----
label_scen_lookup <- cur_scen_map %>%
  group_by(app_name, label) %>%
  summarise(logical_scenario = first(logical_scenario), .groups = "drop")

error_details_enriched <- error_details_cur %>%
  left_join(error_summary_cur %>% select(app_name, label, total_transactions, tx_errors = errors, tx_error_rate = error_rate),
            by = c("app_name", "label")) %>%
  left_join(label_scen_lookup, by = c("app_name", "label")) %>%
  mutate(
    logical_scenario = ifelse(is.na(logical_scenario), "-", logical_scenario),
    http_code_clean  = ifelse(is.na(responseCode) | responseCode %in% c("", "0", "NA", "N/A"), "Non-HTTP", paste0("HTTP ", responseCode)),
    error_msg_clean  = ifelse(is.na(responseMessage) | responseMessage %in% c("", "0", "NA"), "No error message recorded", responseMessage),
    share_of_errors  = if (total_run_errors > 0) round((error_count / total_run_errors) * 100, 1) else 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(error_count), desc(tx_errors), label)

render_modal_error_table <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#16A34A; font-weight:600; padding:12px 0;'>✓ No HTTP or transaction errors recorded.</p>")
  }
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    sprintf(
      "<tr>
         <td style='font-weight:600;'>%s</td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;'>%s</td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>
         <td style='text-align:center;'><span class='hd-http-badge'>%s</span></td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;color:#1E293B;word-break:break-word;'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#DC2626;'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f%%</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'><span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-fail'>%.1f%%</span></td>
       </tr>",
      r$app_name,
      r$logical_scenario,
      r$label,
      htmlEscape(r$http_code_clean),
      htmlEscape(r$error_msg_clean),
      format(r$error_count, big.mark = ","),
      format(r$total_transactions, big.mark = ","),
      r$tx_error_rate,
      r$share_of_errors
    )
  })

  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>App</th>
          <th>Scenario</th>
          <th>Transaction</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">HTTP Code</th>
          <th>Error / Response Message</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Errors</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Total Tx</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Tx Error Rate</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Share of All Errors</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8E. Build Performance Glossary Tables ----
glossary_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cat_id, ~category, ~term, ~formula, ~interpretation,
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Max Virtual Users (VU)", "COUNT(DISTINCT user_index)", "Peak number of concurrent simulated users active during the test execution. Validates whether the target concurrency load was achieved.",
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Throughput (TPS)", "Successful Transactions / Test Duration (secs)", "Rate of successful transactions processed per second across an Application, Scenario, or the entire Run. Higher TPS indicates stronger system capacity.",
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Total Requests / Transactions", "COUNT(*) across the test window", "Total volume of transaction samples executed during the run (including both passed and failed requests). Used to verify test workload volume against baseline.",
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", paste0(rt_metric_name, " Response Time (ms)"), sprintf("QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %.2f)", rt_percentile), sprintf("The %s percentile transaction response time in milliseconds. %d%% of executed requests completed at or below this latency, isolating user experience from extreme single-request outliers.", rt_metric_name, round(rt_percentile * 100)),
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", "SLA Threshold & Tolerance Band", "Threshold * (1 + Tolerance % / 100)", "Maximum acceptable response time configured per transaction (or default fallback) in sla.yaml. A transaction passes if its actual percentile RT stays within the threshold plus any configured tolerance band.",
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", "Apdex (Application Performance Index)", "(Satisfied + 0.5 * Tolerating) / Total Samples", "An open international standard (0.00 to 1.00) measuring end-user satisfaction. Each transaction is judged against its specific target threshold (T): Satisfied (elapsed <= T), Tolerating (T < elapsed <= 4T), Frustrated (elapsed > 4T or HTTP Error). Automatically adapts to transactions with inherently longer operations (such as file uploads/downloads) without false penalties. Industry ratings: >= 0.94 Excellent, >= 0.85 Good, >= 0.70 Fair, >= 0.50 Poor, < 0.50 Unacceptable.",
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", "Variance / Impact vs SLA (▲ +X%)", "((Actual RT - SLA Threshold) / SLA Threshold) * 100", "Percentage by which a transaction exceeded (▲ +X% breach) or remained below (▼ -X% headroom) its configured Response Time SLA threshold.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Overall Status (PASS / FAIL)", "VU Pass AND App TPS Pass AND Scenario RT Pass AND Scenario Error Pass", "Top-level executive release gate. Evaluates to PASS only when all four SLA dimensions pass across all tested applications and scenarios.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Scenario (Logical Scenario)", "Grouped by Business Process (Injector IP stripped)", "A user journey or business process group (e.g., BP01_DW (Students), BP02_DW (Staffs), BP03_Mobile) aggregated across all load generators. A Scenario passes RT SLA only when 100% of its transactions pass.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Transactions Met RT SLA (X of Y)", "Passed Transactions / Total Distinct Transactions in Scenario", "Proportion of distinct transaction steps within a Scenario or Application whose percentile response time satisfied the SLA threshold.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "TPS / Error / RT SLA Pass Rate (%)", "(Passed Entities / Total Entities) * 100", "Scorecard pass rates in the Current vs Baseline Comparison table measuring the percentage of Applications (for TPS), Scenarios (for Error Rate), and Transactions (for Response Time) that met SLA.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Baseline Delta (▲ / ▼ %)", "((Current - Baseline) / Baseline) * 100", "Relative percentage change compared to the Baseline Run. Color-coded by metric polarity: green when performance improved (higher TPS, or lower Response Time / Error Rate) and red when degraded.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Error Rate (%)", "(Failed Transactions / Total Transactions) * 100", "Percentage of transactions that returned non-success status or HTTP errors. Evaluated against the configured Application Error Rate SLA threshold.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Error Pareto & Cumulative Share (Σ%)", "(Transaction Errors / Total Run Errors) * 100", "Ranks failing transactions from highest to lowest error count, showing each transaction's individual share (%) and running cumulative share (Σ%) of all test errors to isolate the top root-cause contributors.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "HTTP Code & Response Message", "Grouped by HTTP Status Code & JMeter/Tool Message", "Granular failure breakdown inside the HTTP Errors drilldown modal showing exact HTTP status codes (e.g., HTTP 500, HTTP 502, Non-HTTP timeout) and server error messages per transaction."
)

render_modal_glossary_table <- function(df) {
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    sprintf(
      "<tr>
         <td style='font-weight:700; width:21%%;'>%s</td>
         <td style='width:16%%;'><span class='total-app'>%s</span></td>
         <td style='font-family:Consolas,monospace; font-size:11px; color:#2563EB; font-weight:600; width:24%%;'>%s</td>
         <td style='line-height:1.4; width:39%%;'>%s</td>
       </tr>",
      htmlEscape(r$term),
      htmlEscape(r$category),
      htmlEscape(r$formula),
      htmlEscape(r$interpretation)
    )
  })

  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Performance Term / Metric</th>
          <th>Category</th>
          <th>Formula / Basis</th>
          <th>Definition &amp; Executive Interpretation</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8E-bis. SLA Configuration & Thresholds Modal ----
cfg_sla <- if (exists("sla_config") && !is.null(sla_config)) {
  sla_config
} else if (!is.null(cfg$sla_rules) || !is.null(cfg$response_time_sla)) {
  cfg
} else if (!is.null(cfg$sla_file_path) && file.exists(here::here(cfg$sla_file_path))) {
  yaml::read_yaml(here::here(cfg$sla_file_path))
} else NULL

rt_sla    <- if (!is.null(cfg_sla)) cfg_sla$response_time_sla else NULL
sla_rules <- if (!is.null(cfg_sla)) cfg_sla$sla_rules else NULL

tps_rule <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, "throughput"), sla_rules)
tps_rule <- if (length(tps_rule) > 0) tps_rule[[1]] else NULL

er_rule <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, "error_rate"), sla_rules)
er_rule <- if (length(er_rule) > 0) er_rule[[1]] else NULL

vu_rule <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, "total_users"), sla_rules)
vu_rule <- if (length(vu_rule) > 0) vu_rule[[1]] else NULL

rt_metric_str <- if (!is.null(rt_sla) && !is.null(rt_sla$metric)) toupper(rt_sla$metric) else "P95"
rt_default_val <- if (!is.null(rt_sla) && !is.null(rt_sla$default_threshold)) format(round(as.numeric(rt_sla$default_threshold)), big.mark = ",") else "3,000"
rt_unit_str <- if (!is.null(rt_sla) && !is.null(rt_sla$unit)) rt_sla$unit else "ms"
rt_tol_str <- if (!is.null(rt_sla) && !is.null(rt_sla$tolerance_pct)) paste0(rt_sla$tolerance_pct, "%") else "0% (strict)"

rt_rows <- c()
rt_rows <- c(rt_rows, sprintf(
  "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Global Default (Unlisted Transactions)</td><td><span style='background:#E0E7FF;color:#3730A3;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>Global Fallback</span></td><td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#1E293B;'>%s %s</td><td>Tolerance: %s. Applies to any transaction not specifically overridden below.</td></tr>",
  rt_default_val, rt_unit_str, rt_tol_str
))
if (!is.null(rt_sla$overrides) && length(rt_sla$overrides) > 0) {
  for (ov in rt_sla$overrides) {
    ov_type <- if (grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", ov$label) && nchar(ov$label) > 20) "Exact Match" else "Prefix Match"
    rt_rows <- c(rt_rows, sprintf(
      "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'><code>%s</code></td><td><span style='background:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</span></td><td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#1E293B;'>%s %s</td><td>Custom threshold rule for %s flows matching '<code>%s</code>'.</td></tr>",
      ov$label, ov_type, format(round(as.numeric(ov$threshold)), big.mark = ","), rt_unit_str, ov$label, ov$label
    ))
  }
}
slarules_rt_table_html <- sprintf(
  '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:6px;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Scope / Transaction Pattern</th>
        <th>Match Type</th>
        <th class="numeric-header">Threshold (%s)</th>
        <th>Rule Description &amp; Application</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>%s</tbody>
  </table>',
  rt_unit_str, paste(rt_rows, collapse = "\n")
)

tps_rows <- c()
tps_default_val <- if (!is.null(tps_rule) && !is.null(tps_rule$threshold)) as.numeric(tps_rule$threshold) else 5.1
tps_rows <- c(tps_rows, sprintf(
  "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Global Estate Baseline</td><td style='text-align:center;'><span style='background:#E0E7FF;color:#3730A3;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>Baseline Rule</span></td><td style='text-align:center;font-weight:600;'>&gt;=</td><td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#1E293B;'>%.2f TPS</td><td>Default throughput threshold required across applications.</td></tr>",
  tps_default_val
))
if (!is.null(tps_rule) && !is.null(tps_rule$application_thresholds) && length(tps_rule$application_thresholds) > 0) {
  for (at in tps_rule$application_thresholds) {
    tps_rows <- c(tps_rows, sprintf(
      "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'><span style='background:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>App Override</span></td><td style='text-align:center;font-weight:600;'>&gt;=</td><td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#1E293B;'>%.2f TPS</td><td>Specific sustained throughput requirement for %s.</td></tr>",
      at$app_name, as.numeric(at$threshold), at$app_name
    ))
  }
}
slarules_tps_table_html <- sprintf(
  '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:6px;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Application Scope</th>

# ---- 8F. Build Pure-CSS Radio/Checkbox State Machine + Pre-Rendered Modal Shell ----
build_mode_tab_state <- function(mode, tab_ids) {
  inputs <- sapply(seq_along(tab_ids), function(idx) {
    tid <- tab_ids[idx]
    chk <- if (idx == 1) " checked" else ""
    sprintf('<input type="radio" name="hd-tab-%s" id="hd-tab-%s-%s" class="hd-state-input"%s />', mode, mode, tid, chk)
  })
  css_rules <- sapply(tab_ids, function(tid) {
    paste0(
      sprintf('#hd-tab-%s-%s:checked ~ .hd-viewport label[for="hd-tab-%s-%s"] { background:#2563EB !important; color:#FFFFFF !important; border-color:#2563EB !important; }\n', mode, tid, mode, tid),
      sprintf('#hd-tab-%s-%s:checked ~ .hd-viewport #%s-data-%s { display:block !important; }', mode, tid, mode, tid)
    )
  })
  list(
    inputs = paste(inputs, collapse = "\n"),
    css    = paste(css_rules, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

st_error    <- build_mode_tab_state("error", error_tab_ids)
st_slarules <- build_mode_tab_state("slarules", slarules_tab_ids)
st_glossary <- build_mode_tab_state("glossary", glossary_tab_ids)

  '        <label for="hd-mode-error" class="hd-modal-mode-btn" data-mode="error" data-open-mode="error" style="background:#1E293B; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin:0;">⚠️ HTTP Errors</label>',
  if (isTRUE(any_sla_enabled)) '        <label for="hd-mode-slarules" class="hd-modal-mode-btn" data-mode="slarules" data-open-mode="slarules" data-open-tab="ALL" style="background:#1E293B; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin:0;">⚖️ SLA Criteria</label>' else '',
  '        <label for="hd-mode-glossary" class="hd-modal-mode-btn" data-mode="glossary" data-open-mode="glossary" style="background:#1E293B; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin:0;">📖 Glossary</label>',
  if (has_evidence) '        <label for="hd-mode-evidence" class="hd-modal-mode-btn" data-mode="evidence" data-open-mode="evidence" data-open-tab="ALL" style="background:#1E293B; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin:0;">🖥 Infrastructure</label>' else '',
  '        <label for="hd-mode-closed" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#ffffff; font-size:22px; cursor:pointer; line-height:1; padding:0 6px; margin-left:6px; margin-bottom:0;">&times;</label>',
  '      </div>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div class="hd-modal-filter-bar">',
  '      <span style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:#64748B; text-transform:uppercase; margin-right:4px; flex-shrink:0;">Filter:</span>',
  '      <div id="hd-modal-tabs" style="display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; flex:1;">',
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="charts">%s</div>', charts_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="sla">%s</div>', sla_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="scenario">%s</div>', scenario_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="label">%s</div>', label_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="error">%s</div>', error_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="slarules">%s</div>', slarules_tabs_html),
  sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="glossary">%s</div>', glossary_tabs_html),
  if (has_evidence) sprintf('        <div class="hd-filter-group" data-mode="evidence">%s</div>', evidence_tabs_html) else '',
  '      </div>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div id="hd-modal-body" class="hd-modal-body">',
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="charts">%s</div>', charts_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="sla">%s</div>', sla_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="scenario">%s</div>', scenario_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="label">%s</div>', label_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="error">%s</div>', error_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="slarules">%s</div>', slarules_panels_html),
  sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="glossary">%s</div>', glossary_panels_html),
  if (has_evidence) sprintf('      <div class="hd-panel-group" data-mode="evidence">%s</div>', evidence_panels_html) else '',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div class="hd-modal-footer">',
  '      <small style="color:#64748B; font-size:11px;">💡 Tip: Use the top-right switcher buttons or filter pills to navigate between Executive Charts, SLA Status, Scenarios, Transaction RT Breaches, HTTP Errors, SLA Criteria, and the Performance Glossary. Press <kbd style="background:#E2E8F0; color:#0F172A; padding:1px 5px; border-radius:3px;">ESC</kbd> to close.</small>',
  '      <label for="hd-mode-closed" style="background:#334155; color:#ffffff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 14px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; margin:0;">Close</label>',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '</div>',
  scen_tx_modal_html,
  '<script>
(function() {
  try {
    var existingIcon = document.querySelector("body link[rel=\'icon\']");
    if (existingIcon && document.head) {
      document.head.appendChild(existingIcon);
    }
    var navTitleEl = document.querySelector(".hd-report-navbar-title");
    if (navTitleEl && navTitleEl.innerText) {
      document.title = navTitleEl.innerText;
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  var themeCheckbox = document.getElementById("hd-theme-toggle-state");
  function syncThemeFromCheckbox() {
    if (!themeCheckbox) return;
    var isDark = themeCheckbox.checked;
    if (isDark) {
      document.body.classList.add("dark-theme");
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove("dark-theme");
    }
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("aper_report_theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (themeCheckbox) {
    themeCheckbox.addEventListener("change", syncThemeFromCheckbox);
    try {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("aper_report_theme");
      if (savedTheme === "dark") {
        themeCheckbox.checked = true;
        document.body.classList.add("dark-theme");
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  window.toggleReportTheme = function() {
    if (themeCheckbox) {
      themeCheckbox.checked = !themeCheckbox.checked;
      syncThemeFromCheckbox();
    }
  };

  function showDrilldown(mode, tabId, appId) {
    var modeRadio = document.getElementById("hd-mode-" + mode);
    if (modeRadio) modeRadio.checked = true;
    if (tabId) {
      var tabRadio = document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-" + tabId);
      if (!tabRadio) {
        tabRadio = document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-GRID") ||
                   document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-ALL") ||
                   document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-BREACHES");
      }
      if (tabRadio) tabRadio.checked = true;
    }
    if (mode === "charts") {
      var targetChartApp = appId;
      if (!targetChartApp) {
        var checkedChartApp = document.querySelector("input[name=hd-charts-app-filter]:checked");
        if (checkedChartApp && checkedChartApp.id) {
          targetChartApp = checkedChartApp.id.replace("hd-charts-app-", "");
        }
      }
      if (!targetChartApp) {
        var checkedScenApp = document.querySelector("input[name=hd-scen-filter-app]:checked");
        if (checkedScenApp && checkedScenApp.id) {
          targetChartApp = checkedScenApp.id.replace("hd-scen-app-", "");
        }
      }
      if (targetChartApp) {
        var chartAppRadio = document.getElementById("hd-charts-app-" + targetChartApp);
        if (chartAppRadio) chartAppRadio.checked = true;
      }
    }
    var body = document.getElementById("hd-modal-body");
    if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  window.openChartsModal   = function(viewId, appId) { showDrilldown("charts",   viewId || "GRID", appId); };
  window.openDistributionModal = function(appId)     { showDrilldown("charts",   "DISTRIBUTION", appId || "ALL"); };
  window.openSlaModal      = function(appId)  { showDrilldown("sla",      appId  || "ALL"); };
  window.openScenarioModal = function(appId)  { showDrilldown("scenario", appId  || "ALL"); };
  window.openLabelModal    = function(scenId) { showDrilldown("label",    scenId || "BREACHES"); };
  window.openErrorModal    = function(txId)   { showDrilldown("error",    txId   || "ALL"); };
  window.openGlossaryModal = function(catId)  { showDrilldown("glossary", catId  || "ALL"); };
  window.openSlaRulesModal = function(tabId)  { showDrilldown("slarules", tabId  || "ALL"); };

  window.closeDrilldownModal = function() {
    var scenClosedRadio = document.getElementById("hd-scen-drill-closed");
    if (scenClosedRadio && !scenClosedRadio.checked) {
      scenClosedRadio.checked = true;
      return;
    }
    var closedRadio = document.getElementById("hd-mode-closed");
    if (closedRadio) closedRadio.checked = true;
  };

  // Delegated click handler for table rows and buttons with data-open-mode + data-open-tab
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    var trigger = e.target.closest("[data-open-mode]");
    if (trigger) {
      var mode = trigger.getAttribute("data-open-mode");
      var tab  = trigger.getAttribute("data-open-tab");
      var app  = trigger.getAttribute("data-app");
      if (mode && tab) {
        showDrilldown(mode, tab, app);
      }
    }
    var chartAppTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-charts-app]");
    if (chartAppTrigger) {
      var targetApp = chartAppTrigger.getAttribute("data-charts-app");
      var radio = document.getElementById("hd-charts-app-" + targetApp);
      if (radio) {
        radio.checked = true;
        try { radio.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); } catch(e) {}
      }
    }
    var scenAppTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-scen-app]");
    if (scenAppTrigger) {
      var targetScenApp = scenAppTrigger.getAttribute("data-scen-app");
      var scenRadio = document.getElementById("hd-scen-app-" + targetScenApp);
      if (scenRadio) scenRadio.checked = true;
    }
    var tabBtn = e.target.closest(".hd-modal-tab-btn");
    if (tabBtn) {
      var body = document.getElementById("hd-modal-body");
      if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
      var txBody = document.getElementById("hd-scen-tx-modal-body");
      if (txBody) txBody.scrollTop = 0;
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") window.closeDrilldownModal();
  });
})();
</script>'
)

# ============================================================
# 9. ZONE 5: COMPACT SLA / TELEMETRY DISCLAIMER
# ============================================================
disclaimer_html <- if (isTRUE(any_sla_enabled)) {
  '<div class="hd-disclaimer-strip">
     <strong>⚠ Note: </strong>SLA evaluations and release criteria are assessed programmatically on client-side metrics (Response Time, Error Rate, TPS, Concurrency). Server-side infrastructure evidence (CPU/Memory) is provided for observational reference only and requires separate engineering monitoring sign-off.
   </div>'
} else {
  '<div class="hd-disclaimer-strip">
     <strong>⚠ Note: </strong>Performance metrics (Response Time, Error Rate, TPS, Concurrency) are aggregated programmatically from client-side test telemetry. Server-side infrastructure evidence (CPU/Memory) is provided for observational reference only and requires separate engineering monitoring sign-off.
   </div>'
}

# ============================================================
# 10. ASSEMBLE FULL SINGLE-VIEWPORT OUTPUT
# ============================================================
full_viewport_html <- paste0(
  root_state_inputs_html,
  '\n<div class="hd-viewport">',
  report_navbar_html,
  top_bar_html,
  kpi_row_html,
  app_matrix_card_html,
  mid_grid_html,
  bot_grid_html,
  disclaimer_html,
  modal_html,
  '</div>'
)

knitr::raw_html(full_viewport_html)
